headline: Trump, Putin and Xi: what world media write about the results of the meeting in China
summary: The first trilateral meeting of the leaders of China, the United States and Russia drew varied assessments in international media. American outlets pointed to a lack of specifics in the outcome, according to the summary.
why: Relations among the US, China and Russia shape sanctions, trade flows and energy and commodity markets worldwide.
original_headline: Трамп, Путин и Си: что мировые СМИ пишут об итогах встречи в Китае
